THE POSSIBILITYVessel No. 01Stoneware, imagined in motion.

01 THE MATERIAL

It begins
with earth.

Before the silhouette, the surface, the shine.
Just clay. Cool to the touch, carrying the
possibility of something yet to exist.

STATERaw & full of possibility
01

02 THE MOVEMENT

A little water.
A quiet rhythm.

The wheel turns. An uneven mass gathers
around a single point. Before a form can rise,
it must first find its center.

STATECentered, softened, ready
02

03 THE GESTURE

Space,
held by clay.

The walls rise. A hollow opens.
Small gestures leave their trace in the surface.
A vessel finds its own character.

STATEThrown & taking shape
03

04 THE PAUSE

Some things
take time.

Moisture leaves. The surface softens to matte.
The foot is refined. What once yielded
to a touch begins to hold its own.

STATEDrying & becoming still
04

05 THE TRANSFORMATION

Altered
by fire.

Clay becomes ceramic. A coating becomes
a surface of depth and light. Inside the kiln,
the familiar becomes something lasting.

01 / BISQUE02 / GLAZE03 / FIRE04 / COOL

Two firings. One irreversible transformation.

05

06 THE OBJECT

Made slowly.
Meant to stay.

A little earth, given a second life.
Explore the surface. Find your own perspective.
